Epic.guidance: Epic usually requires Clarity or Chronicles access. Ensure you are connecting to the read-only reporting mirror if available.

Cerner.guidance: Cerner Millennium instances often use numeric schema identifiers (e.g. P001). Check the oracle/sql instance name carefully.

Meditech.guidance: Meditech data is typically sourced from the Data Repository (DR). Ensure the DR sync agent is active.

Allscripts.guidance: Allscripts Sunrise uses the 'Works' database for clinical records.

NextGen.guidance: NextGen typically stores patient data in 'NGData'.
